references.text: God reveals himself to Abraham as El Shaddai (God Almighty)
Isaac blesses Jacob and mentions El Shaddai
God reveals himself to Jacob as El Shaddai
Jacob remembers that El Shaddai revealed himself to him in Luz
Jacob uses the name Shaddai in his blessing over Joseph
God reveals his name YHWH to Moses at the burning bush
Confirms that YHWH is God's name, the Most High over all the earth
God promises that his people will know his name
God recalls that he made himself known to Israel in Egypt and revealed his name
Jesus uses the divine name 'I am' (ἐγὼ εἰμί) and links it to the YHWH revelation
God calls himself παντοκράτωρ (the Almighty), which corresponds to El Shaddai
